text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day. Before training, Gran Alegria was 
focusing her mind to the radio when...

text_block_list.name: Radio Personality
text_block_list.text:
"Next up is a special feature on gourmet 
history! We'll be highlighting—the famous 
salad loved even by legendary Umamusume!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
...H-Huh? I thought I just heard someone 
say 'salad'...

text_block_list.name: Radio Personality
text_block_list.text:
"The secret to that crisp texture isn't 
just soaking the lettuce in ice water—!? 
Find out right after the commercial 
break~!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Waaah!? Right, of course you were talking 
about salads!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Just this! Let me just finish listening to 
this!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Gran Alegria ended up skipping her 
training while listening to a radio show.
